shapes.line: Thirty six clubs in one table, eight different opponents, four home and four away. Top eight into the round of 16; places 9 to 24 play two legged playoffs. No away goals rule. Qualification and the fixture draw are simulated; coefficient pots and association limits are not modelled.
Eight groups of four into the round of 16, two legged ties, away goals count double. That is the real 2020-21 format.
